profile.title: Full Stack Developer
profile.introduction: Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of experience building modern web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and scalable backend architectures.
profile.bio: I'm a Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of experience building web and mobile applications. My primary expertise is in ReactJS, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and NestJS. I focus on writing maintainable code, creating intuitive user experiences, and delivering scalable products that solve real business problems.

description: Designed, developed and maintained scalable web applications using ReactJS, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing products.
Integrated RESTful APIs, optimized application performance and enhanced user experience.
Participated in Agile development processes, code reviews and technical discussions.
Built responsive and interactive user interfaces using ReactJS, JavaScript and modern frontend technologies.
Worked closely with designers and backend developers to implement product requirements.
Maintained and improved application quality through bug fixes and performance optimizations.
Contributed to feature planning, estimation and sprint activities in an Agile environment.
Delivered custom web and mobile solutions for clients across multiple industries.
Gathered requirements, designed technical solutions and implemented end-to-end features.
Developed frontend interfaces, backend services and database integrations.
Provided ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting and performance improvements.
